parsed.name: MFLI 锁相放大器
parsed.description: MFLI 是一款数字锁相放大器，用于在强噪声背景下提取微弱交流信号的幅值和相位信息，常用于电学表征、输运测量、扫描探针实验以及其他需要相敏检测的实验室测量。
parsed.description_en: The MFLI is a digital lock-in amplifier used to extract the amplitude and phase of weak AC signals in noisy environments. It is commonly used for electrical characterization, transport measurements, scanning probe experiments, and other laboratory measurements requiring phase-sensitive detection.
